lastReport.summary:
**Daily audit note – 20 November 2026**

Two council membership changes were proposed today and are worth residents' attention.

**Council change #18: proposal to add a new council member.** At 08:50 UTC, account 0xC782…f834 proposed adding account 0x0C5F…5777 to the council. The proposal's description says the aim is to "seat a trusted second person… in place of the setup account." This matters because council members have authority over governance decisions, so any change to who sits on the council is significant. The proposal uses the standard (not fast-track) process. Transaction: 0x5638…da48.

**Council change #19: proposal to remove the setup account.** Five seconds later, the same account, 0xC782…f834, proposed removing itself from the council. The description says its key "was held by the setup assistant." Together with #18, this would replace the original setup account with the new member. This also uses the standard process. Transaction: 0xcdd4…eed0.

**Summary:** There were no other alerts today. Both proposals came from the same account and neither has been carried out yet. Residents may want to follow how they proceed through the normal review process.
